page.layout: One printed page (left page of an opening, with the gutter at right showing fragments of the facing page). Running head at top: page number "118" at top left, running title "ARITHMETICÆ" centred. Main text in one column with a woodcut initial S. Italic paragraphs in the middle. Catchword "Com-" at lower right of the column. Right-hand strip shows cropped text of the facing page, which is not transcribed as it is cut off mid-word.

main_text.p: {S}IMPLICIS hucusque proportionis tum directæ, tum reciprocæ tractatio, exemplis illustrata est : sequitur Multiplex.
Multiplex proportio est, quam termini plures quatuor conficiunt.

p.i: Disiunêta proportio simplex in quatuor terminis fuit, Multiplex in pluribus erit, ut cum unius rationis plures sunt consequêtes, ad unum antecedentem, uel contrà, aut cum duo sunt ordines binis numeris proportionales, aut alio simili modo.

main_text.p: Est autem duplex, terminis composita, uel continuata. Composita est, quæ plures terminos proportionales in unû conductos assumit.
Harum Prima datos terminos multos, aut unica tantùm numerandi forma coponit, utpote uel additione, uel multiplicatione : aut pluribus, ut additione & multiplicatione simul.

p.i: Composita siue Ratio, siue Proportio dicitur, in qua termini compositi sunt. Quæ uerò componuntur, ex plu-ribus coagmentantur, idq; bifariam, uel addendo, uel multiplicando separatim, Euclidis etiam testimonio, uel utroq; modo simul.

page.notes: The facing page is only partly visible at the right edge; its fragments (e.g. "pl", "fec", "tis", "qua", "mar") are cropped and not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "coponit" and "Disiunêta" are as printed. The woodcut initial S is marked as {S}.
